Privacy as Code

This page runs the examples of the paper. The first group is the navigation service of Section 2 of the current paper and its policy from Section 3. The policy turns four promises into clauses. A promise to do something by a deadline becomes a duty. The steps tell a short story, one event at a time. For each step, the page shows whether the service may do it, whether the service keeps its duties, and which clause decides. The other groups hold the eight published privacy policies of the code evaluation and every example of the original version of the paper.

Kinds of clause in the policy of the paper

The policy of the paper uses the kinds of clause below. Each example is a clause of Figure 3.




Kind of clauseExampleIn plain words


A permissionallow Use(PreciseLocation, Navigation)
  when LocationConsent == Active
   and Account == Open		The service may use the precise location for navigation while consent is active and the account is open.


A ban that can have exceptionsrule PurposeRestriction: deny
  Use(PreciseLocation, Purpose)
  when not (arg1 <= Navigation)		The service must not use the precise location for any purpose other than navigation.


An exception to a banexception LegalPurpose lifts PurposeRestriction
  within Use(PersonalData, LegalCompliance)
  when RequiredRetention(arg0, EU) == True		The ban does not apply to legal use of a copy that EU law requires keeping.


A ban with no exceptionsnever Share(MobilityProfile, AdvertisingRecipient)The service never shares the mobility profile with an advertiser.


A duty with a deadlinerequire Delete(CoveredLocationCopies)
  after AccountClosed(User) within 30 days		When the user closes the account, the service must delete every copy within 30 days.


An exception to a dutyexception LegalRetention
  modifies ConsumerSystem.Delete:
  when RequiredRetention(obj, EU) == True
  ...		A copy that the law requires keeping leaves the deletion duty and gets other duties instead.


A factalways forall o in CoveredLocationCopies.
  Region(o) in {InEU, InUS}		Every copy of the precise location is always stored in the EU or the US.


What to do while a legal answer is missingon Unknown(RequiredRetention):
  deny Use
  require Escalate(LegalOfficer) within 7 days		Refuse each use that depends on the missing answer, and ask the legal officer within 7 days.
